digest.component_or_area: completion-verification close gate, plan-review close gate
propositions: When a ticket's acceptance criteria no longer match the codebase due to subsequent work, the completion verifier blocks close and agents resort to --force-close or --ref to old commits, both of which leave inaccurate state in the ticket system.
Closing against stale criteria via --force-close or --ref leaves the ticket permanently claiming something untrue of the codebase, corrupting the shared durable ticket record.
The legitimate path for invalidated criteria is to edit the ticket for accuracy, re-pass plan review, and close against corrected criteria; this path must be documented.
The plan-review close gate's stale-regver check forces full re-review of already-executed plans when the criteria registry changes, stranding completed work without a sanctioned closure path.
Acceptance criteria that are auto-generated or unverifiable have no ref point at which they can be satisfied, leaving no escape hatch for genuine completion.
